audit.whatIsWrong: phases[].side read 'Skill' at every stage while win[] and the packet's levelChart both said Brand wins six of seven stages and Taric only takes the 2+ items stage.
audit.why: The two layers rendered contradictory answers to who wins each stage. The packet also flags its own winRate (55.8% Taric) as looking odd next to a 6-1 Brand chart, but a champion can lose lane hard and still win the overall game through scaling/utility, so that is not itself a layer disagreement.
audit.corrected: Re-aligned phases[0-5].side to Brand and phases[6].side to Taric to match win[]/packet.levelChart, with why rewritten per row to match.

audit.why: Spikes already correctly named: the level-2 Pillar/Q-stun poke window, the level-6 Cosmic Radiance answer to Pyroclasm, and the two-item all-in flip.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named Sear as 'matchup-defining' with no digit; dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were the tradeGood/tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.why: Sear is 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s and only stuns an ablazed target — the real cooldown tells you when it's actually safe to step up. Pyroclasm's bounces prioritize stacking Blaze on champions, so standing apart from your ADC denies the double-chain — neither fact was stated anywhere on the page.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field now carries real Sear and Cosmic Radiance numbers; dosFull[1] restates the ablaze-conditional stun as the actual dodge rule; dontsFull[2] states the Pyroclasm bounce-spread rule.

edits.before: Bravado-weave the trades — the empowered autos refund cooldowns; the loop is the lane.
edits.after: Brand's ranged W-Q poke outranges your melee kit from level 1 with no answer.

edits.before: Q-charges bank heals: the gemstone economy opens.
edits.after: His Pillar-plus-stun pins you down at level 2 hard.

edits.before: Full kit: W-link the carry and the E stuns from two bodies — the double angle is the trap.
edits.after: His ablaze poke and stacked detonation still out-damage your setup badly at level 3.

edits.before: Stun the margins off the link's geometry — their spacing answers two Tarics.
edits.after: His cheap-cooldown harass and detonation burst still control the lane through 4-5.

edits.before: Cosmic Radiance online — dives on your duo meet a scheduled invulnerability.
edits.after: Cosmic Radiance blanks one burst, but his poke edge still keeps him ahead.

edits.before: First item: the stuns chain and the heals compound.
edits.after: First item: his range still beats your heal throughput.

edits.before: Late Taric un-kills teamfights: R the dive, link the carry, and stun the formation twice per rotation.
edits.after: Late Taric flips it: magic resist, Bastion, and invuln finally overpower his poke and long R cooldown.

edits.before: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — Q only stuns the ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge. It writes your spacing rules. - R Cosmic Radiance is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Brand Sear (Stun): 8s at rank 1, down to 6s by rank 5 — Q only stuns an ablazed target; after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge. - Your R Cosmic Radiance is 180s at rank 1, 120s at rank 3 — save it, do not season trades with it.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Sear only stuns while a target is ablaze -- dodge the Q on cooldown and Blaze ticks out with nothing to punish you.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with intentions.
edits.after: Pyroclasm bounces toward Blaze-stacked targets -- spread from your ADC so it cannot chain you both.

notes: packet.defects flags an apparent contradiction between the 55.8% Taric winRate and a Brand-favored levelChart; treated as not-actually-contradictory (lane loss vs. game win are different things) since content win[] and the packet's own levelChart already agree with each other. Full layer alone was out of sync and is fixed here.
